payload.claim: Criteria 4-6 wire `make check`/`make lint` around `prek run --all-files --stage manual <hook-id>`, but this sandbox has no `prek` binary and no network access, so the flag spelling could not be verified; `pre-commit`, the tool prek mirrors, uses `--hook-stage` for this purpose. If prek's real flag differs from `--stage`, the built recipe would fail for every real invocation, yet none of the named witnesses would catch it: criterion 4's witness only parses `.pre-commit-config.yaml`/`Makefile` as text, and criteria 5-6's witness runs against a stub `prek` that merely logs its arguments rather than a real binary, so a wrong flag would still read as a passing build.
